definitions.explanation: An accomplishment of historic or remarkable scale, the kind praised in news reports and speeches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前人未到|ぜんじんみとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偉業|いぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げた→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偉業|いぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{語|かた}り{継|つ}がれている→語り継ぐ：22312_kataritsugu⟧。
examples.english: His great achievements are still talked about today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{偉業|いぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{国中|くにじゅう}→国中：27766_kunijuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沸|わ}いた→沸く：01122_waku⟧。
examples.english: The whole country was thrilled by the feat of the first gold medal ever won by a Japanese athlete.

notes:
Not used for ordinary personal successes such as passing an exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉業|いぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げる→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧: to accomplish a great feat
- {偉業|いぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧: to achieve a great feat
- {前人未到|ぜんじんみとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{偉業|いぎょう}: an unprecedented achievement

SIMILAR WORDS:
